freezes.rule: freezedetect n=0.003 d=1.4 at native resolution on the master
freezes.opening: 0.47-1.84 s is the cold-open fade (1.37 s)

flash.note: one slow brightening, the break-up crossfade at 429.7-430.5 s; no repeated flashes

text_blocks: caption + distance counter at any time (plus the small 'Thought experiment' badge); never more than two lines of caption
counter_synced_to_voice: each distance key is timed from the aligned sentence that says the number (build_timeline.py)
notes: Chapter 1 reworked after the coordinator's feedback: Moon placed below the caption from the first frame, sunbeam starts below the readout.
